item.tib: snyan rgyud zhi gcod kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsgrubs chung
item.coloph: de ltar snyan rgyud zab mo 'khor ba dang(dong) sprug gi rjes gnang / gsal bar bya ba'i rim pa ni/ lce sgom bdag gis grogs pos bskur (bskul) phyir sbyar ba 'di/ nyes 'gal byung na yum gyis (gyi) klong du bshags/ dge des 'gro kun mkha' spyod thob 'gyur shog mkha' 'gro dbang gi rjes gnang 'di/ lce sgom dbang rgyal la ri khrod pa rgyal mtshan blo gros gyis (kyis) zhus/ de la bdag 'bru btsun shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa legs s+ho//
